howTo.title: How it works
howTo.item1: The plugin needs no configuration. After activation the filter is available to every user who may open the order overview.
howTo.item2: Found under Orders > Overview > filter sidebar > field Invoice number (at the bottom).
howTo.item3: The number has to match exactly: 100 does not find 1000. Several numbers can be separated by commas.
howTo.item4: Regular invoices and ZUGFeRD e-invoices count as invoices. Cancellation invoices, credit notes, delivery notes and other documents are ignored, even with the same number.

info.description: Invoice number filter for the order overview.
